document_id: Cavaleri 2019 - The October 29, 2018 storm in Northern Italy – An exceptional event and its modeling

impacts.description: Fourth highest historical level of flooding in Venice since 1872

evidence.quote: The actual sea level peak was reached at 13 UTC, fourth highest historical level of flooding in Venice since 1872, the starting year of the measurements.

impacts.description: Surge extent of 1.30 m around 18 UTC

evidence.quote: Note the extent of the surge around 18 UTC, in itself 1.30 m, that only by a lucky optimal phase difference with the astronomical tide did not lead to the by far worst flood in history.
